profile.headline: Engineering at EarnIn | ex- Nextdoor, Meta, Expedia
profile.summary: Passionate software engineer with 10+ years’ experience, aim to work in a challenging environment with creative ideas. A clear understanding of business procedures, Ability to work under pressure, and strict deadlines. Quick learner, clear communicator, and adaptable to new design patterns/frameworks for fast and quality development.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
- Optimized database hit rate by refactoring code base and distributed cache resulted in a 25% speed improvement.
- Led the project to an onboard a new vendor and collaborated with different teams to deliver, which had a high impact on business ~3.7 mn per annum. 
- Migrated old spring jobs from in house data center to AWS serverless Lambda and CloudWatch which eliminated the cost of running server in the data center.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineer in Hotwire car rental backend team, working with data scientists to improve the selection of good quality inventory and achieve low rates with good profits for the company.
• Involve in building highly scalable containerized microservices and deploy on AWS.
• Actively working on redesigning the monolithic application to Docker-based containerized microservices.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Contributed Software development expertise to develop software products for integration between Insurance companies and Repair Body Shop using Agile Scrum Software management methodology.
• Redesigned JBoss based enterprise event notification service to Docker-based containerized microservice using Spring boot.
• Built a DAO layer using the Hibernate ORM framework and mapped java object to database entity using JPA annotations.
• Created Java POJOs for marshaling and unmarshalling  JSON requests/response using Jackson libraries.
• Participated in pushing java logs to ElasticSearch database and visualize it using Kibana and improved monitoring capabilities for the services.
• Implemented enterprise java messaging service using Spring JMS and HornetQ.
• Developed automation test API for deployment smoke test and reduced manual testing effort from 2 hours to 30 minutes.
• Implemented Restful APIs using JAX-RS with JBOSS rest easy and also involved in refactoring existing services and resolved 80% bugs.
• Involved in building Micro Service using Spring Boot and Docker container.
• Implemented SSO (Single Sign-On) protocol using OAuth 2.0 to help customers to access multiple resources with a one-time login.


Technologies - 
OOP(Java, C#), Spring, Hibernate, REST with JAX-RS, EJB 3.0, JMS, Spring Boot, JBoss, Docker, JUnit, Mockito, PowerMockito, Eclipse.

honors.title: Gold Star Award
honors.description: Awarded with gold star performer of the year. This award recognizes few employees with excellent performance throughout the year.

honors.title: Team Player Award
honors.description: Received team player award for demonstrating ability and skill working in a team environment.
honors.issuer: Issued by Mitchell International Inc · May 2017

projects.title: Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer Game
projects.description:
•	Created a multiplayer online game using Maven with Spring MVC Architecture and Hibernate as an ORM tool.
•	The user can play as a guest with the computer or with other players. One can also save the game and resume it later and also can                                     serve the summary of the total number of played games like wining rate, losing rate both, against AI player as well as 2nd player.
•	In addition to that, also implemented Graphical user interfaces using CSS3 and HTML5 technologies.

projects.title: Course Planner
projects.description:
•	Implemented course planner web application wherein students can plan their course schedules during their academic quarters.  
•	The application also displays which subjects they can take in their upcoming semesters depending on past records of the subjects already taken by them.
